sql:
SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.CUST_ID, O.ORDER_DT, O.MEMO
  FROM MBC_ORDERS O
 WHERE O.CUST_ID = :custId
   AND O.ORDER_DT >= :fromDt
   AND O.MEMO <> ':x & y' -- :note
 ORDER BY O.ORDER_NO
element:
<select id="selectMbcOrders">
  <![CDATA[
    SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.CUST_ID, O.ORDER_DT, O.MEMO
      FROM MBC_ORDERS O
     WHERE O.CUST_ID = #{custId}
       AND O.ORDER_DT >= #{fromDt,jdbcType=DATE}
       AND O.MEMO <> ':x & y' -- :note
     ORDER BY O.ORDER_NO
  ]]>
</select>

<select id="selectMbcOrders2">
    SELECT * FROM MBC_ORDERS WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
</select>

sql:
UPDATE MBC_ORDERS
   SET STATUS = :status
 WHERE CUST_ID = :custId
element:
<update id="updateMbcOrders">
    UPDATE MBC_ORDERS
       SET STATUS = #{status}
     WHERE CUST_ID = #{custId}
</update>

<delete id="deleteMbcOrders">
  <![CDATA[
    DELETE FROM MBC_ORDERS WHERE ORDER_NO <= #{maxNo}
  ]]>
</delete>
